verdict.rationale: Windmill documents reusable scripts and functions being composed into flows through its orchestrator, so the 'reusable modules' half of the story is directly supported. Nothing in the pack shows a flow calling another flow as a sub-workflow, or how shared modules are versioned or referenced across flows. missing for 10: explicit sub-flow (flow-calling-flow) documentation, details on referencing/versioning shared modules across workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call

citations.quote: Scripts are turned into sharable UIs automatically, and can be composed together into flows or used into richer apps built with low-code.
An orchestrator for assembling these functions into efficient, low-latency flows, using either a low-code builder or YAML
